correctness.rationale: The trace-free matrix model has L² Gram 2 tr(AB)/[d(d+2)]. Signs and absolute coordinates separate, and multiplying ∑S_i=0 by one and by three distinct signs gives pair and four-sign moments −1/(d−1) and 3/[(d−1)(d−3)]. The Dirichlet magnitude moments then give the squarefree block with entries 1, −2/[π(d−1)], and 12/[π²(d−1)(d−3)] (same edge, intersecting, disjoint). For the unsigned incidence matrix N, NᵀN=2I+A for the intersecting-edge adjacency A and NNᵀ=(d−2)I+J. This gives the stated three edge-sector eigenvalues and multiplicities without assuming the representation decomposition. For a trace-free diagonal u the mixed moment on edge ij is −√2(u_i+u_j)/[π(d−1)], so only the standard sector mixes, with coupling g_d and the two eigenvalues ℓ_{d,±}. The diagonal block is identity and the listed multiplicities exhaust the space, also after complexification. Positivity follows from polynomial nonvanishing on an open cone. Writing C=π(d−3), the determinant of c_d I minus the mixed block has numerator 6(d−2)(C²+12C+24) over π⁴(d−1)²(d−3)², and c_d exceeds both diagonal entries. Since a_d<1<ℓ_{d,+}, the sign of the determinant at a_d compares a_d to ℓ_{d,−}; its sign is that of d(4π²−18π+18)−π², with threshold strictly between 10 and 12 by the stated rational bounds. The exact squared condition numbers and their limit follow, with all unconditioned eigenvalues scaled by p_d.
residual_risks: The claim is for even d≥4 and pure degree two, excluding constants. The frozen script's sampled dimensions lie on the d≤10 side only; the exact determinant, not those tests, establishes the crossover and the entire higher-dimensional regime.

value.rationale: Sharp observability of pure quadratics from an exactly balanced sign mask is a natural concentration problem. The complete spectrum identifies which symmetry mode limits stability and proves that this mode changes between d=10 and 12. The sharp relative conditioning remains bounded as the observed area tends to zero. The switch and mixed spectrum give usable mathematics beyond the known squarefree block or a finite numerical comparison.
residual_risks: Bounded squared relative conditioning does not give an absolute lower bound on restriction energy, or optimality among masks.
